text_block_list.text:
"—*pant*, *wheeze*. Insolent little pest! 
Finally managed to drive it out..."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Barging into my castle with muddy feet...! 
Perhaps I should place things she despises 
in her way!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh, who knew they had habits like 
that...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Uuu... I feel absolutely 
terrible...
